items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 201:1
items.html: On Shabbat, when the worlds ascend to Atzilut, the world of Atzilut is discerned by the name "city", for there is all the settlement, and about it it is said, "let no man go out of his place on the Shabbat day". And up to the Chazeh [chest] of Beriah is the secret of the seventy cubits and the remainder, which are added to the city in the secret of the expansion of the city. And from there to the Chazeh of Yetzirah is the secret of the two thousand cubits of the Shabbat boundary. And from the Chazeh of Yetzirah and downward is a permanent dwelling place for the Klipot, and there it is outside the Shabbat boundary, from which it is forbidden to go out, as it is said, "let no man go out of his place on the Shabbat day". (Item 84).
